title: Activity Service — Mario Sameh (55-0677)
description: S4-READ-DB observability dashboard — 3 LogQL panels for activity-service

panels.title: Panel 1 — Error Rate (activity-service)
panels.description: Count of ERROR-level log lines per minute. A spike means something is broken — check Feign calls to itinerary-service first.

panels.title: Panel 2 — Feign Call Outcomes (activity-service → itinerary-service)
panels.description: Successful Feign responses vs FeignException catches over 5 minutes. Detects when itinerary-service is degraded so S4-F2 and S4-F4 start failing.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="tripplanning", service="activity-service"} | json | message =~ "itinerary-service.getItinerary returned successfully" [5m]))
sum(count_over_time({app="tripplanning", service="activity-service"} | json | message =~ "Feign call to itinerary-service failed" [5m]))

panels.title: Panel 3 — Activity Created Log Stream
panels.description: Live log lines where an activity was persisted. Filter by itineraryId to trace which itinerary triggered the creation. Verifies S4-F2 and S4-F4 call Feign before inserting rows.
